pages.text: Some witches redraw whole circles by hand. Richer or lazier ones persuade the circle to rewrite itself.$(br2)Glyphic Transformation changes an existing ring from one chalk family to another. It does not create a circle from nothing. It only retunes marks that are already there.

Work the rite by offering the chalk family you want the circle to become: ordinary $(item)Chalk$(), $(item)Otherwhere Chalk$(), or $(item)Infernal Chalk$(). The rite also asks for $(item)Gypsum$(), an $(item)Arthana$(), and $(bold)1000 altar power$(/). The Arthana is returned when the work is done.

pages.title: Choosing the Ring
pages.text: The live port follows the old practical rule: the amount of matching dropped chalk decides which ring is rewritten. $(bold)1$(/) chalk changes the small ring, $(bold)2$(/) changes the medium ring, and $(bold)3$(/) changes the large ring. Use it when you already have the right geometry drawn, but need to retune one circle family without starting over from bare ground.
